verdict.rationale: Grafana documents dynamic, reusable dashboards with template variables shown as dropdowns (grafana-gh-3). It covers a broad visualization suite from time series to heatmaps to 3D charts, extensible via panel plugins (grafana-docs-48, grafana-gh-8, grafana-gh-9). Community users praise its graphs and panels (grafana-comm-2, grafana-comm-5), and dashboards can be defined as version-controlled files that teams share (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-3). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-product sharing features (share links, snapshots, embedding or permissions), and the community notes some visualization limits (Node graph data requirements) and thin dashboard-building documentation (grafana-comm-3, grafana-comm-10).
